nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Only allow the wall run to begin if:\r
- The player character was moving in the direction of the wall during the previous tick (we use the previous tick\'s velocity because if the wall detection trace is triggered during the same tick that the character\'s capsule hits the wall, the current velocity reflects the post-impact velocity, which is not useful to us here)\r
OR\r
- The player is providing movement input in the direction of the wall\r
\r
If the result of the dot products are negative, the character (or its input vector) is moving towards the wall. If it\'s positive, they\'re moving away from the wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_9

nodes.comment: Reset the float that tracks how long the current wall run has been active. This is used to control the arc of the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_10
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Initialize the current rotation as the "PreviousRotation" to get rid of any outdated data from a past wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Only start the wall run if it is allowed.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_80
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Apply all the necessary movement settings for the wall run.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Start a timer that tracks the player\'s speed at certain intervals to identify if the wall run has gotten stuck on something.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_84
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Clear any existing velocity on the character so that the wall run always behaves consistently (otherwise the run\'s distance/height could be affected by the velocity the character had when the run began). This also prevents old velocity values from negatively affecting the arc angle animation blend, which is based on velocity.
